name: Fail Crew
source: In Fail Crew you the reader decide the fate for 4 very stupid highschoolers as they cross realms , smoking crack, cutting them selfs and killing the innocent. Fail Crew itself is very very offensive. If your not into that then don't read. If you are then you should be very pleased.
translation: 在《失败小队》中，故事的命运由读者决定：四名愚蠢至极的高中生穿越不同领域，抽食可卡因、自残，还杀害无辜者。本作内容极具冒犯性。如果你不喜欢这类题材，请不要阅读；如果你喜欢，应该会非常满意。
